import asyncio
import re
from explore_parsed import call_json

def clean_html(raw):
    text = re.sub(r'</(p|div|h[1-6]|li|tr|ul|ol|table)>', '\n', raw)
    text = re.sub(r'<(br|hr)\s*/?>', '\n', text)
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)
    import html
    text = html.unescape(text)
    return re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n', text).strip()

async def main():
    cursor = None
    all_pages = []
    while True:
        args = {"limit": 100, "body-format": "storage"}
        if cursor:
            args["cursor"] = cursor
        pages = await call_json("confluence-gym", "get_pages", args)
        for p in pages.get("results", []):
            all_pages.append(p)
        links = pages.get("_links", {})
        next_link = links.get("next")
        if next_link and "cursor=" in next_link:
            cursor = next_link.split("cursor=")[1].split("&")[0]
